adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential-sync mode is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), it returns the result of `fetch(...)`, i.e., a `Response` object, not a parsed token object. In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow was changed to `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken = await refreshOAuthTokens(..., "hubspot", credential.userId)`, but there is no corresponding parsing/normalization (unlike other integrations that added `parseRefreshTokenResponse`). Therefore, in credential-sync mode HubSpot code will treat a `Response` as `HubspotToken`, making fields like `expiresIn`/`expires_in` undefined and downstream expiry calculations/persistence incorrect.
